original_agent_description: Node-aware Design Rule Check agent. Runs KLayout and/or Magic batch DRC on a GDS/OASIS/DEF layout and reports the violation count with a per-rule breakdown and waiver adjudication. On sky130/open PDKs it runs BOTH engines because their decks catch complementary rules; the design is clean only when every engine is clean. DRC is a mandatory tapeout gate: zero un-waived violations to sign off. Consumes the PDK Binding (KLayout deck + Magic tech). Emits a Common Design Envelope. Validated on sky130.
